steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Door-open tub light check
steps.body: Open door — tub light should illuminate (12 V PWM drive). Light may time out after several minutes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open door — tub light should illuminate (12 V PWM drive). Light may time out after several minutes.

steps.title: Disconnect P9
steps.body: Power off. Remove toe and outer door panels. Verify P9 seated. Disconnect P9 from control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Remove toe and outer door panels. Verify P9 seated. Disconnect P9 from control.

steps.title: Tub LED passes diode check?
steps.body: Diode mode: numeric reading anode→cathode; OL cathode→anode on tub LED assembly.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Diode mode: numeric reading anode→cathode; OL cathode→anode on tub LED assembly.

steps.title: Continue after Service Diagnostics entry
steps.body: Service Diagnostics should be available (1-2-3 entry, press Key #2, close door to start). Continue with live checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Refer to strip circuit; use Service Diagnostics Cycle for live load verification.

steps.title: 12 V PWM at P9 (door open, P9 unplugged)?
steps.body: Power on, door open: verify 12 V PWM drive at tub light circuit per strip diagram (P9).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power on, door open: verify 12 V PWM drive at tub light circuit per strip diagram (P9).

steps.title: Replace tub light
steps.body: Replace failed tub light assembly and retest.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace failed tub light assembly and retest.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.body: LED good but no PWM output — replace control.
steps.oemOutcome: LED good but no PWM output — replace control.
